simple.meaning: מַטְבֵּחַ (maṭbêach) is a Hebrew word meaning “slaughter.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H4293. matbeach מַטְבֵּחַ noun [masculine] slaughtering-place (Phoenician מטבח id. CIS i. 175 ), Isa 14:21 , for Babylonians (under implicit figurative of animals).

occurrences.englishText: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.
